wickra-embed's C++ layer is written for bare-metal toolchains (no heap, no exceptions, no RTTI); its example builds as C++11 to hold that floor. Every other C++ example builds as C++17.

wickra-zk's floor is 1.90 because risc0 needs it: risc0-binfmt 3.0.5 requires ruint 1.20.1, which declares rust-version 1.90. Every other workspace is on the family's 1.86.

wickra's one setup-dotnet step installs .NET 10 for the cross-library benchmark harness (bindings/csharp/cross-library), because QuanTAlib 0.8.12 ships for .NET 10 only; its binding tests run on the runner's preinstalled SDK as before. Every other repository installs 8.0.
wickra's binding, tests and examples target net8.0 like the family; only the cross-library benchmark harness targets net10.0, because QuanTAlib 0.8.12 ships for .NET 10 only.
